name: spending-effort-with-jev
description: Shows which /effort level each message needs, the moment you send it, judged by TypeSafe's Jev. Based on 'Using Claude Code: Spending your effort'. Unofficial.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to use the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the suggestions: en or zh.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Only show a line when a switch is suggested.

ask_before_upgrade.title: Ask before upgrading
ask_before_upgrade.description: When a message needs more effort than the session has, Claude asks whether to switch before it starts.
